selector.rationale: Ependymoma best explains the decisive findings of a well-demarcated, homogeneous mass in the fourth ventricle with surrounding edema and obstructive hydrocephalus, without strong contradictions.

rejected.label: Cerebellar astrocytoma
rejected.why: less specific location and less homogeneous appearance

rejected.label: Choroid Plexus Papilloma
rejected.why: less common in adults and less likely to cause surrounding edema

rejected.label: Medulloblastoma
rejected.why: although a strong candidate, the lack of contrast enhancement and calcifications makes Ependymoma a more specific diagnosis
